nav.occasionsHint: Pick an occasion to start with matching designs.

hero.title: Invitations as beautiful as the occasion.
hero.body: Write once in Hindi, Tamil, Marathi or any of 12 languages. Get a printed-quality card, a WhatsApp-ready video and an RSVP website, in two minutes.

how.title: From names to a ready invite in three steps
how.s1b: Names, dates, venue. Type or speak. AI writes the wording in your language.
how.s2b: Your own names on every design, instantly. Switch colours with one tap.
how.s3b: Card for WhatsApp, video with music, and a website link with RSVP.

outputs.title: One form. Three invitations.
outputs.cardBody: Multi-page, print-quality card. Ready for WhatsApp, status and the press.
outputs.videoBody: Animated with music, always under 16 MB so WhatsApp never blurs it.
outputs.siteBody: Schedule, maps, countdown and an RSVP for each function — with every guest greeted by name.

send.title: Send to a whole list, one tap each
send.body: WhatsApp opens with each guest's message ready, written in {language}. Send, come back, tap the next. Free: it goes from your own WhatsApp.
send.inviteHint: Their invitation with a personal link
send.dayBeforeHint: See you tomorrow, with venue and map
send.thanksHint: After the event, with the photo album
send.saveTheDateHint: Before the full invitation is ready
send.wall: Photo wall for the venue TV

share.f_imageHelp: JPG pages for WhatsApp status and chats.
share.f_videoHelp: MP4 with music, sized for WhatsApp. Takes 1–3 minutes.
share.f_site_videoHelp: Your website design as a film: cinematic, 15-second save-the-date reel or storybook (choose in Website → Look).
share.f_pdfHelp: All pages in one file, with a QR code to your website.
share.f_print_pdfHelp: 5×7 inch, 300 DPI, bleed and crop marks.
share.published: Published. Your link is ready to share.
share.siteLive: One link with every function, the map and RSVP. Send it to groups, or add guests for personal links.
share.siteDraft: Publish to get a link you can send. You can keep editing after.
share.filesBody: Each file is made from your latest details. Make it again after you change something.

edit.clipStarted: Your cinematic intro is being made. It is added to the video automatically in a few minutes.
edit.wordsBody: What your guests read. Changes show on the card, the video and the website.
edit.title: Title
edit.titleHint: Shown on your dashboard and in link previews.
edit.heading: Heading
edit.name: Name
edit.designBody: Switch any time. Your words stay the same.
edit.photosBody: Up to 6 photos. Turn one into a hand-drawn caricature, or paint a background in your design's colours.
edit.bgBody: A one-of-a-kind painted background in your design's colours.
edit.clipBody: A 6-second film-style opening for your video invite.
edit.musicBody: Plays in the video, and on the website with a website plan.
edit.askStay: Ask if they need a stay

pages.saved: Saved. Your card pages are updated.
pages.needFields: Every function needs a name, date and venue.
pages.title: Card pages
pages.body: These fill the extra pages of your invitation: a page for your ceremonies, a family & RSVP page and a save-the-date page. Leave anything blank to skip it. You can also delete any page in the editor.
pages.name: Name
pages.heading: Heading
pages.welcomeHint: e.g. Swagatotsuk, Darshanabhilashi, Eagerly awaiting you
pages.complimentsHint: e.g. With best compliments from, सौजन्य से
pages.rsvpByHint: Shown on the card and used by the website's RSVP form.
pages.noteHint: e.g. Your blessings are our gift. Kindly no boxed gifts.

upgrade.badCoupon: This coupon code is not valid.
upgrade.title: Upgrade this invitation
upgrade.body: One-time payment for this event only. No subscription.
upgrade.secure: Secure payment by UPI, card or wallet. Unlocks instantly.

print.sent: Request sent. The press will share a quote on WhatsApp within a day.
print.lockTitle: Print the same design on real card
print.lockBody: Get a print-ready PDF for any printer, or order printed cards from a partner press near you.
print.s1: Make the print-ready PDF in the Share tab
print.s2: Tell us how many cards and where to send them
print.s3: The press sends a quote on WhatsApp within a day
print.cardsBody: Pick a press, or let us find the nearest one.
print.noPayment: No payment now. The press replies with a quote first.
print.name: Name

guests.nobody: Nobody to send to in this list
guests.title: Guests
guests.body: Every guest gets a personal link that greets them by name. You see who opened it and who replied.
guests.emptyBody: One by one, paste a list from Excel or your notes, or pick from your phone contacts. You can send everyone their link on WhatsApp after.
guests.name: Name
guests.groupHint: e.g. "Family", "Office", "Bride side". Show some website sections only to a group.
guests.pasteHint: One guest per line: name, mobile, group. Works with copy-paste from Excel.
guests.sentHint: See who opened them in the list. Remind the rest later with one tap.
guests.noNumberAsk: No number: WhatsApp will ask whom to send to
guests.staySaved: Saved. The guest sees it on their page.

replies.lockBody: Guests reply for each function, with how many people are coming and their meal choice. You get a live headcount for the caterer.
replies.p1: Replies per function: Haldi yes, Reception no
replies.title: Replies
replies.body: Updates on its own every 30 seconds.
replies.emptyBody: Replies appear here as guests answer on the website. Send personal links from the Guests tab to get answers faster.
replies.checkIn: Check guests in at the gate
replies.mealsOff: Turn on "Ask meal preference" in Details to get veg / Jain / non-veg counts per function.

gifts.title: Shagun & gifts
gifts.body: Guests can tell you on the website what they sent (UPI, cash or a gift). Write down envelopes from the venue too, then thank everyone on WhatsApp. The money always goes straight to you.
gifts.tip: Tip: add the Gifts section with your UPI id in the website builder so guests can scan and pay, then tell you here.
gifts.emptyBody: Entries from guests and the family appear here, newest first.

family.joinedToast: {email} can now help with this invitation
family.stdOff: The full invitation is open to guests
family.title: Co-hosts
family.body: Let family members help: add guests, send WhatsApp messages, check people in at the gate. They sign in with their own email.
family.noneOwner: Add a sibling, parent or friend below.
family.onlyOwner: Only the person who created this invitation can add co-hosts or pay for upgrades.
family.stdOnBody: Guests see only the names, date and a countdown. Release the full invitation when the details are final.
family.stdOffBody: Send an early save-the-date before the venue and schedule are final. The website shows a short teaser until you release it.

followUps.title: Follow-ups
followUps.autoOn: Sending automatically on WhatsApp, 9 am to 8 pm.
followUps.autoOff: Reminders, a day-before message and a thank-you. Choose when.
followUps.dayBefore: Day-before message with venue and map
followUps.thanks: Thank-you after the event, with the photo album
followUps.auto: Send these automatically from the Noyta WhatsApp number
followUps.autoPaid: Only to guests with a mobile number, each message once.
followUps.autoFree: Part of the Website plan. Without it, due guests wait in the lists above for you to tap through.

import.tooBig: That file is too big. Up to 2 MB, about 20,000 guests.
import.noContacts: No contacts found in that file.
import.excel: In Excel, choose File → Save As → CSV, then upload that file. Or copy the rows and paste them.
import.uploadAria: Upload a CSV or contacts (.vcf) file
import.readyNoPhone: {n} guests ready, {bad} without a valid mobile number.

day.noCamera: Could not open the camera. Allow camera access, or search by name.
day.title: Check-in
day.search: Search guest by name or mobile
day.noScan: Scanning works in Chrome on Android. On this device, search by name instead.
day.signIn: Sign in to see this list.
day.wallEmpty: Guests' photos will appear here as they add them.
